content:
I was looking for the lemma MulAction.properSMul_iff_isCompact_setOfPred_inter_nonempty and I realized that the docstrings of this lemma mentioned using CompactlyCoherentSpace, but actually CompactlyGeneratedSpace was used (which is stronger). I fixed this and some other minor things in this PR #43135.

I do however have some further questions on this but didn't feel I should change these without asking:

  • Why is this file (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/ProperAction/CompactlyGenerated.lean) and the file Mathlib/Topology/Maps/Proper/CompactlyGenerated.lean named after CompactlyGenerated instead of CompactlyCoherent? It seems to me by reading the docstrings that the CompactlyGenerated typeclass was used in this files years back but it isn't anymore. I was wondering if there is a reason for keeping the names like this.
  • Also in the docstrings of many results they still mention compactly generated spaces, even when the hypothesis are compactly coherent. I understand that, since in all these cases we also assume T2, in this case it is equivalent, and that compactly generated is more tipically used in the literature. But wouldn't it be less confusing(?) to simply say compactly coherent here?

One more general question:

  • Should you always import as few files as possible? For example in this PR I kept both Mathlib.Topology.Compactness.CompactlyCoherentSpace and Mathlib.Topology.Maps.Proper.CompactlyGenerated since it was already like that before, but really you just need the latter as the former is imported by the other. So should I then delete the "unnecessary" import?

Regarding Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/ProperAction/CompactlyGenerated it looks like the change in docstring comes from #36904, maybe they forgot to change the hypotheses. For Mathlib/Topology/Maps/Proper/CompactlyGenerated it looks like #32710 weakened the hypotheses but did not correct the docstring and the file name.

I'd say it is better to remove unnecessary imports, although I do not know if there is a consensus.

I see, in the second one there is this comment

They are equivalent (we have both CompactlyGeneratedSpace => CompactlyCoherentSpace and T2Space + CompactlyCoherentSpace => CompactlyGeneratedSpace instances in mathlib, but CompactlyCoherentSpace does not import a big chunk of category theory.

So I guess this might be the reason why the docstrings were not updated
Regarding imports -- hopefully at some point lake shake will start working again and then humans won't have to worry about imports at all.
lake shake already kind of works again, by the way!
